key_findings.finding: Canonical name from questionnaire (myAgentic-IT-Project-team) is not propagated into brand guideline docs.
key_findings.impact: Weakens brand consistency and future external discoverability.

key_findings.finding: Guideline audience statement (AI Project Leads) diverges from questionnaire audience (individual developers + small teams).
key_findings.impact: Messaging may over-index toward enterprise persona and dilute fit for core users.

key_findings.finding: Duplicate brand guideline files exist in two locations with the same role.
key_findings.impact: Increases probability of future document drift and conflicting references.

key_findings.finding: Confirmation modal defaults still use generic copy (Confirm Action, Confirm, Why?) instead of action-specific language.
key_findings.impact: Tone and clarity inconsistency in high-risk interaction moments.

key_findings.finding: Brand guideline color values for success/warning are out of sync with design tokens and UI values.
key_findings.impact: Minor documentation trust issue for contributors.

key_findings.finding: External marketing is explicitly not planned.
key_findings.impact: No immediate external channel coherence risk; scope remains docs+UI.

risks.title: Brand Identity Fragmentation
mitigations: Propagate canonical naming across both guideline files.
Use Command Center as a product descriptor only.

risks.title: Audience-Messaging Misalignment
mitigations: Update mission and audience wording to questionnaire-confirmed target users.

risks.title: Documentation Governance Drift
mitigations: Consolidate to a single source-of-truth guideline and reference it from the secondary location.

risks.title: UX Trust Erosion in Confirm Flows
mitigations: Replace generic confirmation defaults with action-specific microcopy.

recommendations: Propagate canonical naming decision across both brand guideline files and keep Command Center as product surface descriptor, not alternate product name.
Update mission and audience wording in guidelines to reflect questionnaire-confirmed target users (individual developers + small teams).
Consolidate to a single source-of-truth brand guideline file and reference it from the secondary location.
Replace generic confirmation defaults with action-specific strings in confirm modal paths.
Re-sync semantic color table values in docs/brand-guidelines.md with .github/docs/brand/design-tokens.json and UI token usage.
Keep audit scope constrained to repository docs + local UI while questionnaire Q-14-002 remains No.
